package.description: A simple but powerful DVD Authoring tool

en-US.description: A simple but powerful DVD Authoring tool
en-US.longDescription: DVD Flick aims to be a simple but at the same time powerful DVD Authoring tool. It can take a number of video files stored on your computer and turn them into a DVD that will play back on your DVD player, Media Center or Home Cinema Set. You can add additional custom audio tracks, subtitles as well as a menu for easier navigation.
en-US.name: DVD Flick
